The speed of light in the rest frame of the glass is \(u' = 1/n\). The glass moves at velocity \(v\) in the same direction as the light relative to the laboratory. Using the relativistic velocity addition formula with \(c=1\):

\[
u = \frac{u' + v}{1 + u' v} = \frac{1/n + v}{1 + v/n} = \frac{1 + n v}{n + v}.
\]

This matches option (D).

Answer: D
